_comment: Code points kept in the self-hosted WOFF2 subsets: Basic Latin, Latin-1, Vietnamese (Latin Extended-A letters, combining marks (so decomposed input still renders), Latin Extended Additional 1EA0-1EF9) and the punctuation/symbols the site uses. Anything outside falls back to a system font; scripts/check_site.py fails if page text needs a character outside these ranges. Edit here, then run scripts/build-fonts.mjs.
